decisions.statement: A level is the highest rung an attribute's points have reached or passed.
A rung is the points every climb up to that rung has cost together.
The climb to level 1 costs ten points.
The climb to each later level costs ten times the next Fibonacci number.
The rungs are worked out as far as a figure reaches rather than read off a list.
Points short of the next rung leave the level unchanged.
A level is a whole number.
Points of zero or below are level 0.
An attribute with no total at all is level 0.
Nothing here adds up an attribute's points.
Nothing here says how a level is written out.

definition: the level an attribute's total points have climbed to
